name: Image Alt URL Report
author: wpcustom.ca

sections.description:
Image Alt URL Report adds a report under Tools > Image Alt URL Report.

The report:

  • Scans image attachments in the WordPress Media Library.
  • Finds missing or blank Alternative Text values.
  • Shows the image thumbnail, attachment ID, title, URL, and issue.
  • Exports a UTF-8 TXT report that opens correctly in Notepad.
  • Marks attachments whose URL is unavailable as a URL error.

The plugin does not modify images or Alternative Text.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Image Alt URL Report.
  3. Open Tools > Image Alt URL Report.
  4. Click Download TXT Report.

short_description: Find Media Library images with missing Alternative Text and download their URLs in a TXT report.
